frozenNonAccessibleDomBaselines.note: Computed with the repository's canonical role_dom_hash over the released content.html. HHH Campaign 1 is a full current-contract release and claims no part of SSS Campaign 1's legacy exemption. The Accessible edition is deliberately not frozen; the current contract freezes the three fixed-count roles only. For this release the Accessible DOM hash was nevertheless computed at both trees and compared, as 33d2204405c91006fd790de7b5680bfd8129f4b378af10e149ff3a44d152abee, to prove printable parity across all four roles.
